result.brief: 提出端到端智能体广告视频生成框架，通过产品调研生成卖点驱动的分镜来引导冻结视频生成器，并用分镜与视频级奖励联合强化学习，同时构建广告视频基准与评测指标。
result.reason: Agentic framework producing storyboards that drive a frozen video generator, with video-level RL rewards and a new advertising video benchmark; directly serves video generation control and evaluation.
